title.en: Conditional Connectors (unless / as long as / in case / otherwise)
title.es: Conectores condicionales (unless / as long as / in case / otherwise)

text.en: Besides if, several words express a condition. Unless = if … not (“Unless you hurry, you will miss the train.”). As long as and provided (that) = only if (“You can go as long as you finish.”). In case = to be ready for something that might happen (“Take an umbrella in case it rains.”). Otherwise = if not (“Hurry up. Otherwise, you will miss the train.”). Even if = no matter if (“I will go even if it rains.”). The Spanish equivalents are a menos que, siempre que, por si, de lo contrario, aunque.
text.es: Además de if, varias palabras expresan una condición. Unless = if … not («Unless you hurry, you will miss the train.»). As long as y provided (that) = solo si («You can go as long as you finish.»). In case = para estar listo ante algo que podría pasar («Take an umbrella in case it rains.»). Otherwise = si no («Hurry up. Otherwise, you will miss the train.»). Even if = sin importar si («I will go even if it rains.»). Los equivalentes en español son a menos que, siempre que, por si, de lo contrario, aunque.

rows: la forma verbal tras unless para el futuro

text.en: After unless the verb is affirmative, not negative: “Unless you hurry”, not “Unless you don’t hurry”. The future is expressed by the simple present.
text.es: Después de unless el verbo va en afirmativo, no en negativo: «Unless you hurry», no «Unless you don’t hurry». El futuro se expresa con el presente simple.

tr.en: Unless you hurry, you will miss the train.
tr.es: A menos que te apures, perderás el tren.

examples.es: I won't go unless you come with me.

tr.en: I won't go unless you come with me.
tr.es: No voy a ir a menos que vengas conmigo.

title.en: As long as, so long as, provided (that), on condition that, supposing
title.es: As long as, so long as, provided (that), on condition that, supposing

text.en: Only if the condition is met. Provided and providing are more formal. They are also followed by the simple present. So long as means the same as as long as; on condition that is the most formal. Supposing (suppose) introduces an imagined situation: “Supposing you won the lottery, what would you do?”
text.es: Solo si se cumple la condición. Provided y providing son más formales. También van seguidos del presente simple. So long as significa lo mismo que as long as; on condition that es lo más formal. Supposing (suppose) introduce una situación imaginada: «Supposing you won the lottery, what would you do?»

examples.es: You can borrow my car as long as you drive carefully.

tr.en: You can borrow my car as long as you drive carefully.
tr.es: Puedes pedir prestado mi carro siempre que manejes con cuidado.

examples.es: Provided that you pay on time, there is no problem.

tr.en: Provided that you pay on time, there is no problem.
tr.es: Con tal de que pagues a tiempo, no hay problema.

examples.es: Supposing you won the lottery, what would you do?

tr.en: Supposing you won the lottery, what would you do?
tr.es: Supón que ganaras la lotería, ¿qué harías?

title.en: In case: prevention, not a condition

text.en: In case says why you do something: because it might happen. If says when you do it. It is followed by the simple present (the past simple in the past).
text.es: In case dice por qué haces algo: porque podría pasar. If dice cuándo lo haces. Va seguido del presente simple (del pasado simple en el pasado).

examples.es: Take an umbrella in case it rains.

tr.en: Take an umbrella in case it rains.
tr.es: Lleva un paraguas por si llueve.

examples.es: I took a sweater in case it got cold.

tr.en: I took a sweater in case it got cold.
tr.es: Llevé un suéter por si hacía frío.

title.en: Otherwise, even if, whether or not
title.es: Otherwise, even if, whether or not

text.en: Otherwise stands at the start or middle of a separate sentence and gives the consequence: “Hurry up. Otherwise, you will miss the train.” Even if means the condition does not change the plan. Whether … or not: the condition does not matter.
text.es: Otherwise va al inicio o en medio de una oración aparte y da la consecuencia: «Hurry up. Otherwise, you will miss the train.» Even if significa que la condición no cambia el plan. Whether … or not: la condición no importa.

examples.es: Hurry up. Otherwise, you will miss the train.

tr.en: Hurry up. Otherwise, you will miss the train.
tr.es: Apúrate. De lo contrario, perderás el tren.

examples.es: I will go even if it rains.

tr.en: I will go even if it rains.
tr.es: Voy a ir aunque llueva.

text.en: After these words there is no will: not “as long as you will pay”, but “as long as you pay”. Will goes only in the main clause.
text.es: Después de estas palabras no va will: no «as long as you will pay», sino «as long as you pay». Will va solo en la oración principal.

text.en: The Spanish “por si” is not if but in case: “Lleva un paraguas por si llueve” = “Take an umbrella in case it rains”. “If it rains, take an umbrella” means take one only when it rains.
text.es: El «por si» del español no es if sino in case: «Lleva un paraguas por si llueve» = «Take an umbrella in case it rains». «If it rains, take an umbrella» significa que lo lleves solo cuando llueva.

speak.en: Besides «if», several words express a condition. «Unless» means «if not», and the verb after it is affirmative: «Unless you hurry, you will miss the train». «As long as» and «provided that» mean only if. «In case» expresses prevention: «Take an umbrella in case it rains». «Otherwise» means if not. «Even if» means no matter if. After these words comes the simple present, not «will».
speak.es: Además de «if», varias palabras expresan una condición. «Unless» significa «if not», y el verbo después va en afirmativo: «Unless you hurry, you will miss the train». «As long as» y «provided that» significan solo si. «In case» expresa prevención: «Take an umbrella in case it rains». «Otherwise» significa si no. «Even if» significa sin importar si. Después de estas palabras va el presente simple, no «will».

items.sentence: I will lend you the car ___ condition that you drive carefully.

why.en: A formal condition: on condition that + clause.
why.es: Una condición formal: on condition that + cláusula.

in.en: “In condition that” does not exist; you need on condition that.
in.es: «In condition that» no existe; hace falta on condition that.

under.en: “Under condition that” is not correct like this; you need on condition that.
under.es: «Under condition that» no es correcto así; hace falta on condition that.

examples: You can go on condition that you call.
We stay on condition that she agrees.

tr.en: I will lend you the car on condition that you drive carefully.
tr.es: Te prestaré el carro con la condición de que manejes con cuidado.

why.en: Prevention: for the case that it rains (por si llueve): in case.
why.es: Prevención: para el caso de que llueva (por si llueve): in case.

otherwise.en: Otherwise stands in a separate sentence and does not join two clauses.
otherwise.es: Otherwise va en una oración aparte y no une dos cláusulas.

if not.en: “If not it rains” is not a correct sentence; prevention needs in case.
if not.es: «If not it rains» no es una oración correcta; la prevención necesita in case.

examples: Take a coat in case it is cold.
Bring water in case you are thirsty.

tr.en: Take an umbrella in case it rains.
tr.es: Lleva un paraguas por si llueve.

items.sentence: You can borrow my car ___ you drive carefully.

why.en: Only if the condition is met: as long as.
why.es: Solo si se cumple la condición: as long as.

otherwise.en: Otherwise stands in a separate sentence and does not join two clauses.
otherwise.es: Otherwise va en una oración aparte y no une dos cláusulas.

even.en: Even alone does not join clauses; you need even if or even though.
even.es: Even solo no une cláusulas; hace falta even if o even though.

examples: You can go as long as you ask.
I will help as long as you listen.

tr.en: You can borrow my car as long as you drive carefully.
tr.es: Puedes tomar prestado mi carro siempre y cuando manejes con cuidado.

items.sentence: Hurry up. ___, you will miss the train.

why.en: The consequence in a new sentence: Otherwise, …
why.es: La consecuencia en una oración nueva: Otherwise, …

Unless.en: Unless needs a clause after it (Unless you hurry,…) and cannot stand before a comma alone.
Unless.es: Unless necesita una cláusula después (Unless you hurry,…) y no puede ir solo antes de una coma.

In case.en: In case needs a clause after it (In case you are late,…) and cannot stand before a comma alone.
In case.es: In case necesita una cláusula después (In case you are late,…) y no puede ir solo antes de una coma.

examples: Study. Otherwise, you will fail.
Go now. Otherwise, you will be late.

tr.en: Hurry up. Otherwise, you will miss the train.
tr.es: Apúrate. De lo contrario, perderás el tren.

items.sentence: ___ you won the lottery, what would you do?

why.en: An imagined situation with a question: Supposing…
why.es: Una situación imaginada con una pregunta: Supposing…

Unless.en: Unless is a negative condition (if … not); here supposing introduces an imagined situation.
Unless.es: Unless es una condición negativa (if … not); aquí supposing introduce una situación imaginada.

Otherwise.en: Otherwise stands in a separate sentence and does not join two clauses.
Otherwise.es: Otherwise va en una oración aparte y no une dos cláusulas.

examples: Supposing it rains, what then?
Supposing he calls, what will you say?

tr.en: Supposing you won the lottery, what would you do?
tr.es: Suponiendo que ganaras la lotería, ¿qué harías?

items.sentence: You may borrow the book ___ you return it on Monday.

otherwise.en: Otherwise stands in a separate sentence and does not join two clauses.
otherwise.es: Otherwise va en una oración aparte y no une dos cláusulas.

even.en: Even alone does not join clauses; you need even if.
even.es: Even solo no une cláusulas; hace falta even if.

examples: You can stay, providing you pay.
Providing it is cheap, I will buy it.

tr.en: You may borrow the book providing you return it on Monday.
tr.es: Puedes tomar prestado el libro con la condición de que lo devuelvas el lunes.

items.sentence: We will have the picnic ___ it rains.

why.en: The plan stays even if it rains: even if.
why.es: El plan sigue aunque llueva: even if.

otherwise.en: Otherwise stands in a separate sentence and does not join two clauses.
otherwise.es: Otherwise va en una oración aparte y no une dos cláusulas.

as long.en: “As long” is not a full connector; you need as long as.
as long.es: «As long» no es un conector completo; hace falta as long as.

examples: I will go even if it is late.
She will come even if he is there.

tr.en: We will have the picnic even if it rains.
tr.es: Haremos el picnic incluso si llueve.

items.sentence: I took a sweater ___ it got cold.

why.en: Prevention in the past: in case + past simple.
why.es: Prevención en el pasado: in case + pasado simple.

otherwise.en: Otherwise stands in a separate sentence and does not join two clauses.
otherwise.es: Otherwise va en una oración aparte y no une dos cláusulas.

if not.en: “If not it got cold” is not a correct sentence; prevention needs in case.
if not.es: «If not it got cold» no es una oración correcta; la prevención necesita in case.

examples: She took a key in case nobody was home.
I brought food in case we were hungry.

tr.en: I took a sweater in case it got cold.
tr.es: Me llevé un suéter por si hacía frío.

items.sentence: Unless you ___ now, you will be late.

why.en: After unless the verb is affirmative: Unless you leave.
why.es: Después de unless el verbo va en afirmativo: Unless you leave.

don't leave.en: Unless already contains the negation (if … not); a double negative is wrong.
don't leave.es: Unless ya contiene la negación (if … not); la doble negación es incorrecta.

will leave.en: After unless there is no will; the future is expressed by the simple present.
will leave.es: Después de unless no va will; el futuro se expresa con el presente simple.

examples: Unless you stop, I will leave.
Unless he calls, we go.

tr.en: Unless you leave now, you will be late.
tr.es: A menos que te vayas ahora, llegarás tarde.

items.sentence: I'll lend you money as long as you ___ it back.

why.en: After as long as comes the simple present: as long as you pay.
why.es: Después de as long as va el presente simple: as long as you pay.

will pay.en: After as long as there is no will; the will is in the main clause.
will pay.es: Después de as long as no va will; el will está en la oración principal.

would pay.en: Would pay is a conditional form; here the future is expressed by the simple present.
would pay.es: Would pay es una forma condicional; aquí el futuro se expresa con el presente simple.

examples: I will help as long as you ask.
She stays as long as you stay.

tr.en: I'll lend you money as long as you pay it back.
tr.es: Te prestaré dinero siempre y cuando me lo devuelvas.

items.sentence: Take your phone in case she ___.

why.en: After in case comes the simple present: in case she calls.
why.es: Después de in case va el presente simple: in case she calls.

will call.en: After in case there is no will; you need the simple present.
will call.es: Después de in case no va will; hace falta el presente simple.

would call.en: Would call is a conditional form; after in case in a present sentence the simple present is used.
would call.es: Would call es una forma condicional; después de in case en una oración de presente se usa el presente simple.

examples: Take a key in case he comes.
Bring money in case we need it.

tr.en: Take your phone in case she calls.
tr.es: Lleva tu celular por si ella llama.

items.sentence: ___ that you pay on time, there is no problem.

why.en: A formal condition: Provided that + simple present.
why.es: Una condición formal: Provided that + presente simple.

Unless.en: “Unless that” does not exist; unless is not followed by that.
Unless.es: «Unless that» no existe; unless no va seguido de that.

Otherwise.en: “Otherwise that” does not exist; that goes with provided.
Otherwise.es: «Otherwise that» no existe; that va con provided.

examples: Provided that you ask, we help.
Provided that it is cheap, I buy it.

tr.en: Provided that you pay on time, there is no problem.
tr.es: Siempre y cuando pagues a tiempo, no hay problema.

items.sentence: You must wear a seat belt. ___, you may get a fine.

why.en: The consequence in a new sentence: Otherwise, …
why.es: La consecuencia en una oración nueva: Otherwise, …

Unless.en: Unless needs a clause after it and cannot stand alone before a comma.
Unless.es: Unless necesita una cláusula después y no puede ir solo antes de una coma.

As long as.en: As long as needs a clause after it and cannot stand alone before a comma.
As long as.es: As long as necesita una cláusula después y no puede ir solo antes de una coma.

examples: Leave now. Otherwise, you will be late.
Pay. Otherwise, they will call.

tr.en: You must wear a seat belt. Otherwise, you may get a fine.
tr.es: Debes usar el cinturón de seguridad. De lo contrario, te pueden multar.

items.sentence: I don't mind the noise, so ___ as it stops by ten.

why.en: So long as means only if (as long as).
why.es: So long as significa solo si (as long as).

longer.en: “So longer as” does not exist; you need so long as.
longer.es: «So longer as» no existe; hace falta so long as.

length.en: “So length as” does not exist; you need so long as.
length.es: «So length as» no existe; hace falta so long as.

examples: You can stay so long as you are quiet.
So long as it is cheap, I will buy it.

tr.en: I don't mind the noise, so long as it stops by ten.
tr.es: No me importa el ruido, siempre y cuando se detenga para las diez.

items.sentence: You can use my laptop as long as you ___ careful.

why.en: After as long as comes the simple present: as long as you are.
why.es: Después de as long as va el presente simple: as long as you are.

will be.en: After as long as there is no will.
will be.es: Después de as long as no va will.

would be.en: Would be is a conditional form; here you need the simple present.
would be.es: Would be es una forma condicional; aquí hace falta el presente simple.

examples: You can stay as long as you are quiet.
I help as long as you are here.

tr.en: You can use my laptop as long as you are careful.
tr.es: Puedes usar mi laptop siempre y cuando seas cuidadoso.

items.sentence: We will cancel the trip unless the weather ___ better.

why.en: After unless comes the simple present: unless the weather gets better.
why.es: Después de unless va el presente simple: unless the weather gets better.

will get.en: After unless there is no will.
will get.es: Después de unless no va will.

got.en: Got is past; will cancel is about the future, so you need the simple present.
got.es: Got es pasado; will cancel trata del futuro, por eso hace falta el presente simple.

examples: We stay unless it rains.
I go unless she comes.

tr.en: We will cancel the trip unless the weather gets better.
tr.es: Cancelaremos el viaje a menos que el clima mejore.

items.sentence: We are going to the beach ___ it rains or not.

why.en: The condition does not matter: whether … or not.
why.es: La condición no importa: whether … or not.

unless.en: “Unless it rains or not” is not correct; unless is not followed by or not.
unless.es: «Unless it rains or not» no es correcto; unless no va seguido de or not.

otherwise.en: Otherwise stands in a separate sentence and does not join two clauses.
otherwise.es: Otherwise va en una oración aparte y no une dos cláusulas.

examples: I will go whether you come or not.
She wins whether he plays or not.

tr.en: We are going to the beach whether it rains or not.
tr.es: Vamos a ir a la playa, llueva o no.
